mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_key FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.delete_flag = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.permission_key IS NOT NULL AND p.permission_key != '' AND r.delete_flag = 0 AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.name, p.menu_path, p.permission_key, p.type, p.sort, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.delete_flag, p.icon, p.component, p.visible, p.status, p.redirect, p.is_cache, p.is_frame, p.remark FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.parent_id ASC, p.sort ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.name, p.menu_path, p.permission_key, p.type, p.sort, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.delete_flag, p.icon, p.component, p.visible, p.status, p.redirect, p.is_cache, p.is_frame, p.remark FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.delete_flag = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.visible = 1 AND p.type IN (1, 2) AND r.delete_flag = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY p.parent_id ASC, p.sort ASC, p.id ASC
